say:1:1041580801:1.text: A Graveborn lady, a stone golem, and a bat. I assume that makes you the mentor of the world's greatest mage, Merlin.
say:1:1041580801:1.source_cn: 一位亡灵女士，一尊雕像，一只蝙蝠。看来你就是这个世界上...
say:1:1041580801:1.male: A Graveborn lady, a stone golem, and a bat. I assume that makes you the mentor of the world's greatest mage, Merlin.
say:1:1041580801:1.female: A Graveborn lady, a stone golem, and a bat. I assume that makes you the mentor of the world's greatest mage, Merlin.

say:2:1041580802:1.text: I was, once. Though I'm hardly the only one to have held that title.
say:2:1041580802:1.source_cn: 我曾经是，但拥有这个身份的人并不止我一个。

say:3:1041580803:1.text: What brings you here? I hope you aren't here to file a complaint.
say:3:1041580803:1.source_cn: 有什么事？希望你不是来找我告状的。
say:3:1041580803:1.male: What brings you here? I hope you aren't here to file a complaint.
say:3:1041580803:1.female: What brings you here? I hope you aren't here to file a complaint.

say:4:1041580804:1.text: Nothing so serious. I'm simply curious about the teaching methods of Merlin's mentor. Do you think you could teach a fellow like me who knows absolutely nothing about the supernatural?
say:4:1041580804:1.source_cn: 没什么，我只是好奇梅林的导师的教学水平如何，能否教会我...
say:4:1041580804:1.male: Nothing so serious. I'm simply curious about the teaching methods of Merlin's mentor. Do you think you could teach a fellow like me who knows absolutely nothing about the supernatural?
say:4:1041580804:1.female: Nothing so serious. I'm simply curious about the teaching methods of Merlin's mentor. Do you think you could teach a fellow like me who knows absolutely nothing about the supernatural?

say:5:1041580805:1.text: But we can save that for later. Right now, I am far more intrigued by another matter: do people often come to you to complain about Merlin?
say:5:1041580805:1.source_cn: 不过这些可以稍后再论。现在我有一件更好奇的事：常有人向...
say:5:1041580805:1.male: But we can save that for later. Right now, I am far more intrigued by another matter: do people often come to you to complain about Merlin?
say:5:1041580805:1.female: But we can save that for later. Right now, I am far more intrigued by another matter: do people often come to you to complain about Merlin?

say:6:1041580806:1.text: When he was a student, certainly. These days, not so much.
say:6:1041580806:1.source_cn: 学生时代常有，现在几乎没有。
say:6:1041580806:1.male: When he was a student, certainly. These days, not so much.
say:6:1041580806:1.female: When she was a student, certainly. These days, not so much.

say:7:1041580807:1.text: I don't mean to speak ill of him, but Merlin's mischievous streak back then far exceeded anything your imagination could conjure.
say:7:1041580807:1.male: I don't mean to speak ill of him, but Merlin's mischievous streak back then far exceeded anything your imagination could conjure.
say:7:1041580807:1.female: I don't mean to speak ill of her, but Merlin's mischievous streak back then far exceeded anything your imagination could conjure.

say:8:1041580808:1.text: Fascinating. Could you give me a few examples?
say:8:1041580808:1.source_cn: 有意思。能举些例子来说明吗？

say:9:1041580809:1.text: I'm not trying to pry into anyone's private affairs. I'm simply curious about Merlin's more... colorful exploits.
say:9:1041580809:1.source_cn: 啊，别误会，我并不是想窥探谁的隐私，只是单纯好奇梅林的...
say:9:1041580809:1.male: I'm not trying to pry into anyone's private affairs. I'm simply curious about Merlin's more... colorful exploits.
say:9:1041580809:1.female: I'm not trying to pry into anyone's private affairs. I'm simply curious about Merlin's more... colorful exploits.

say:10:1041580810:1.text: After all, I'm considered rather strange myself. I have a habit of doing things others find completely baffling—though I see nothing unusual about them. They're simply too foolish to understand.
say:10:1041580810:1.source_cn: 要知道，在其他人眼里，我也算是一个奇怪的家伙，时常做出...

say:12:1041580812:1.text: Fabricating evidence during an investigation to lure out a suspect. Bending a fire poker with my bare hands to establish authority. Entering someone's home without permission to conduct a search...
say:12:1041580812:1.source_cn: 比如，破案时伪造证据，以此引蛇出洞；徒手掰弯拨火棍来威...

say:13:1041580813:1.text: Oh, and conducting chemical experiments at home, leaving volatile equipment scattered among the dinnerware. That last one seems to try my flatmate's patience the most.
say:13:1041580813:1.source_cn: 哦，还有在家里做化学实验，然后把仪器和餐具混放在一起。...

say:15:1041580815:1.text: I'm sure you and Merlin would get along wonderfully. I sincerely hope that never happens.
say:15:1041580815:1.source_cn: 我确信你一定能和梅林成为非常要好的朋友，但我由衷地希望...
say:15:1041580815:1.male: I'm sure you and Merlin would get along wonderfully. I sincerely hope that never happens.
say:15:1041580815:1.female: I'm sure you and Merlin would get along wonderfully. I sincerely hope that never happens.

say:16:1041580816:1.text: If the two of you start combining your peculiar ideas, I fear both the Mystical House and everyone in it will pay the price.
say:16:1041580816:1.source_cn: 当你们的怪点子碰撞到一起时，神秘屋和这里的人恐怕都要遭殃。
